PGB · FIELD ORDERS · SITE 9

Gravewalker, you are the thirteenth into this valley. Twelve went before you. Three weeks of silence.

Get the relay up. Hold Threshold. Bring ours home.

Extraction: Heron, night twenty. The lake is not safe to land on before then.

Return of issued equipment is expected. Return of personnel is encouraged.

NIGHT 17 · SWARM

Caves: Northwest Cave · North Cave · Northeast Cave · East Cave · South Cave · Southwest Cave

6 pushes

Fast attackers from every cave · keep an escape lane open

Tonight’s caves are marked on the minimap. Edge arrows point to caves beyond its range.

COUNTERS IN TONIGHT’S ATTACK

Shambler · Save your ammo: the knife does the job.

Feral · Too quick for grenades. Let it close and use the shotgun.

Leaper · Shoot it before it lands. Don't try to knife it.

Military · Vests stop bullets. They move together: throw a grenade.

Spider · Its shell turns bullets. Burn it off the wall.

Bomber · Burn it or shoot it far away. Never let it reach you.

Drowned · Too wet to burn. The shotgun tears it apart.

Brute · Plates stop bullets. Blow it up or burn it.

Spitter · Shoot it while it creeps in. Don't get close.

Demon · Fire does nothing. Pour rifle fire into it.

Screamer · Kill the screamer first, with a rifle. It stays out of shotgun range.
